label: Multi-panel KPI dashboard
description: A heterogeneous KPI dashboard of 3-4 panel tiles filling the wide frame. Each tile shows a big tabular value, a label, an optional delta chip, and a mini horizontal progress track whose fill width comes from an inline --pct. Optional eyebrow + title. Tiles stagger in, fills draw scaleX 0->1 (seek-safe), delta chips pop last.
